note: Frozen record of what supabase/migrations contained (652 files, the last 20261019224500) when this repository adopted scripts/verify-repository-conventions.mjs on November 11, 2026, at commit 875a2d8b8. Most of these migrations were imported from the sibling repository before the rules existed here. policyCommentExempt lists the files that create or materially alter a policy without a COMMENT ON POLICY rationale, or use SQL the rationale rule cannot read; duplicateSlugExempt lists the four applied files that repeat an earlier slug. It is a record, not a waiver mechanism: adding a name to either list is a conspicuous diff that has to be argued for in the pull request, and the checker fails if a listed migration no longer exists. Retro-commenting the historical policies is done by a new migration, never by editing an applied one. See docs/conventions/migration-naming.md and docs/conventions/rls-policy-comments.md.

publicTableGrantExempt.reason: REQ-UG-CALENDAR-REMINDERS-APPOINTMENTS-WORKLOAD-20261030: a steward's private booking notes are reached only through the SECURITY DEFINER functions set_appointment_note and get_appointment_notes, which check the caller is the booked steward. The migration revokes all from public, anon, authenticated and service_role on purpose, and scripts/db-contract.json pins empty privileges for all three roles; a Data API grant would widen direct access to another steward's notes.

REQ-UG-UNION-DOCUMENT-INTAKE-PAGE-20261022: contribution file rows are reached only through SECURITY DEFINER RPCs (begin_union_document_contribution for the public form; the service-role inspection, listing and status functions). The migration revokes all from public, anon, authenticated and service_role on purpose, and scripts/db-contract.json pins empty privileges for all three roles; a Data API grant would widen direct access.

SEC-UG-FMLA-FORM-ANSWERS-ENCRYPTION-PARITY-20261022: temporary ciphertext chunks are reached only by the service-role client in api/sensitive-form-files.js after caller-JWT upload-target authorization. The migration deliberately revokes all privileges from PUBLIC, anon and authenticated, and scripts/db-contract.json pins empty privileges for both client roles. Service-role SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE supports encrypted chunk upload, assembly and cleanup; granting authenticated would widen direct member access.

REQ-UG-INVITATION-SUGGESTIONS-AND-ACCESS-REQUESTS-20261030: invitation suggestions and staff-role requests are reached only through SECURITY DEFINER RPCs (submit_member_request, list_my_member_requests, list_member_requests, decide_member_request, approve_member_request_invitation). The migration revokes all from public, anon, authenticated and service_role on purpose, so a direct Data API read or write is refused; a grant would widen direct access to invitee addresses and notes.

REQ-UG-ELECTIONS-MINUTES-NOMINATIONS-FORMS-20261030: nominations and seconds are read and written only through the SECURITY DEFINER functions nominate_for_ballot, second_ballot_nomination, get_open_ballot_nominations, set_ballot_nominations_period and export_ballot_nominations, which check ballot eligibility and the nomination window. The migration revokes all from public, anon, authenticated and service_role on purpose; a Data API grant would let a member read or write nominations around those checks.
